iconicAnchor.label: Detour (1945)
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Edgar G. Ulmer; Producers Releasing Corporation
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The Library of Congress identifies Detour as an enduring gritty noir; its constrained production, fatalism, and shadowed crime-road world make it a useful genre anchor.

sources.title: “Detour”: National Film Registry #4
supports: Detour is a canonical low-budget noir shaped by fatalism, crime-road tension, and expressive production limits.

sources.title: How the French birthed film noir
supports: Dark, foggy, rain-soaked night exteriors and weak practical lights are established noir atmosphere rather than generic monochrome styling.
